name: XDS 喜德盛 AD7
why_interesting: One entry for the classic and 2026 AD7: a T700+T800 carbon aero road bike documented with Shimano 105 Di2, plus a 105 mechanical option for the classic version. The catalog row uses the current 2026 mainland dealer 105 Di2 option; the 2026 TailorX custom-paint program, the X-LAB-branded export build and earlier regional builds stay listed separately because their wheels, tires, weights and prices differ.
missing: Complete-bike weight with size and pedal basis for the 2026 mainland 105 Di2 option
Whether the classic and 2026 frames are identical; the export build lists a UDH-compatible frame and a T47 bottom bracket, which earlier listings do not state
Controlled exact-model frame-stiffness magnitude and reproducible protocol
Current domestic seller, warranty route and final checkout conditions

current_observed_price.price_basis: Brand-store dealer listing, 2026 AD7 Shimano 105 Di2 carbon-wheel option, size M
current_observed_price.conditions: Shown after a ¥3,000 shop reduction from ¥16,980 that the listing said would end on 29 October 2026; same price for the listing's 2026 finish options in size M; shipping included; size M almost sold out; checkout not submitted.

source_note: One colour-neutral entry covers the classic and 2026 AD7. The catalog row uses the 2026 mainland dealer 105 Di2 option, whose carbon wheels are unnamed and whose weight basis is unpublished. The 2026 TailorX program comes from a brand-named XHS post; the X-LAB-branded export build and earlier Hong Kong and Taiwan listings are separate configurations. Fitted tire widths are not promoted to a maximum, and frame identity across years is not assumed. The official mainland store listed no AD7 on 2026-10-27.

facts.listing_identity: XDS / 喜德盛 AD7, classic and 2026 versions; sold abroad as X-LAB AD7
facts.frame_material: T700+T800 carbon aero-tube frame (2026 brand post and the earlier Taiwan listing) with a carbon fork (earlier Taiwan listing and export build); fiber proportions and lay-up are unpublished
facts.wheels: Carbon wheels on the 2026 dealer option (model not named); the 2026 TailorX post names BRANTA C45 SL
facts.complete_weight_references: 2026 mainland dealer option: weight basis unpublished. X-LAB AD7 105 Di2 export build (New Zealand retailer): 8.44 kg in size M. Earlier Taiwan listing: 8.2 kg. Earlier Hong Kong listing: about 8.5 kg at 480 mm. Builds, wheels, sizes and bases differ, so none is assigned to the catalog row.
facts.fitted_tire_references: Fitted widths: 28C on the 2026 mainland dealer option, 30C on the export build and the earlier Hong Kong build, 25C on the earlier Taiwan listing; none establishes the frame maximum
facts.frame_stiffness_status: No controlled exact-model stiffness magnitude or reproducible protocol found after 50 registered source areas
facts.custom_order: 2026 TailorX: nine iridescent and eleven two-tone paint choices; about 4–8 weeks after order confirmation, subject to production scheduling; custom orders cannot be returned or exchanged (brand-named XHS post)
